questions.q: Which type of wave has a strong swash and weak backwash and builds beaches?
questions.why: Constructive waves are low with strong swash, so they deposit material.

questions.q: What is the correct order of landforms when a headland is eroded?
questions.why: A crack becomes a cave, then an arch when it erodes through, then a stack when the roof collapses, then a stump.

questions.q: Which condition is needed for coral reefs to grow?
options: Warm, shallow, clear and salty water
questions.why: Corals need warm water (about 23 to 29 degrees C), sunlight for their algae, salinity and clear water.

questions.q: Explain one disadvantage of building groynes to protect a beach.
questions.model: Groynes trap sand on one side, so the beach further along the coast is starved of sediment. This increases erosion downdrift.
points: beaches further along are starved and eroded faster
